notes: Every primary added failure is retained. Only names failing on the candidate but passing on main in the first paired control receive one further sequential paired diagnostic, with default-reporter logs. The paired summary uses the latest diagnostic per name; the original runs remain linked. Passing an isolated retry is not a passing broad/full suite.
Initial test typecheck failed on the new absence test import; the import was corrected and the final typecheck passed. No production source differs from the pinned base.
